dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a moderate concave curvature (falcate) transitioning from a wide base to a sharp posterior-pointing tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Sharp, acute-angled apex with a very small pixel radius, nearly a single point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree steepness relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.5 times the vertical height from the dorsal ridge to the apex.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, convex curve with a medium radius defining the dorsal-anterior profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum extending approximately 25% of the length of the visible cranial section from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse angle of approximately 135 degrees at the transition point between the melon's descent and the rostrum's projection.

other_distinctive_markers: Body surface exhibits a sparse distribution of small, circular, high-luminance white pixels (speckles) across the teal-colored skin.
